rounding.note: The IESCO tariff guide does not state a rounding rule. Each money component is rounded to the nearest paisa, half up. Products stay exact until that step.

fixed_charge.reason: The IESCO tariff guide states that non-time-of-use fixed charges are the sanctioned load in kW multiplied by the rate for the selected consumption row.

minimum_charge.reason: The IESCO tariff guide says the minimum customer charge does not apply where monthly fixed charges apply.

adjustments.label: GST
adjustments.reason: The IESCO tariff guide for S.R.O. 279(I)/2026 does not state GST.

adjustments.label: Fuel price adjustment
adjustments.reason: The IESCO tariff guide for S.R.O. 279(I)/2026 does not state a fuel price adjustment for this schedule.

adjustments.label: Electricity duty
adjustments.reason: The IESCO tariff guide for S.R.O. 279(I)/2026 does not state electricity duty.

adjustments.label: TV fee
adjustments.reason: The IESCO tariff guide for S.R.O. 279(I)/2026 does not state a TV fee.

source.issuing_authority: Islamabad Electric Supply Company (IESCO), publishing the schedule under S.R.O. 279(I)/2026
source.reference: A-1 Residential table, unprotected rows for sanctioned load up to 5 kW, and the fixed-charge note beneath that table
limitations: Rates were read from the IESCO tariff guide on 2026-11-26. The page cites S.R.O. No. 279(I)/2026, February 2026. The day 12 February 2026 is the date K-Electric states for the same SRO at https://ke.com.pk/faqs/. The gazette PDF itself was not retrieved.
The guide says only protected residential consumers receive one previous slab. This unprotected file charges every unit at the single row that contains total consumption.
This file does not decide whether a household is unprotected. The caller has to confirm that category.
Zero consumption is not inside a listed row. No fixed-charge row is selected for it, and the amount is not set to zero.
The fixed charge is rupees per kW of sanctioned load per month, not a flat amount per connection. Sanctioned load has to be supplied.
GST, fuel price adjustment, electricity duty, and TV fee are not in this schedule. Energy and fixed-charge figures are not a payable bill.
No effective end date was published on the page. A later notification is not included in this file.
